subject: Ops triage: VPC gaps and next steps (commercial ask)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@mednovus.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Ops triage: VPC gaps and next steps (commercial ask)

Thanks for the call today — quick recap and next steps.

Key pain points we heard:
- MedNovus must keep inference traffic inside a private VPC and not cross public subnets (regulatory requirement for patient PII).
- On-prem connectivity will be via a dedicated VPN to your datacenter; you currently have 10Gbps egress and need our runtime to support pinned instances.
- SOC 2 evidence and attestation timing is a blocker for procurement (they need documentation by July 1).

Goals agreed:
- Proof-of-concept with a single isolated model endpoint in your VPC (pilot for 6 weeks).
- Latency SLO target: p95 < 300ms for 512-token requests.
- Commercial target: reserved baseline capacity + burst credits; you asked for a preliminary SKU and discount range.

Technical unknowns / constraints we need from you:
1) Network diagram (subnets, NAT gateways, firewall rules) — you've shared a sketch in the call; please upload the diagram.
2) Outbound egress policy — are we allowed to reach Redwood control-plane over TLS to authenticate? (port 443)
3) Key management preference — KMS vs HSM, and whether keys must be customer-managed in a dedicated HSM.

Attachments: mednovus-netdiag-v1.pdf (diagram stub), redwood-privacy-snapshot.pdf (security overview)

Next steps / owners:
- Sanjay / Priya: upload full network diagram + VPN termination window (by Mon 6/17)
- Ben: schedule a technical deep-dive (network + ops) with your infra lead — target week of 6/24
- Laura: draft a commercial outline (SKU + 90-day pilot discount) and circulate to procurement by 6/16

Would you like Ben and I to include a brief checklist to give to your NetOps team? We can produce a one-page "connectivity preflight" they can hand to the infra group.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
Attachments: mednovus-netdiag-v1.pdf, redwood-privacy-snapshot.pdf
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@mednovus.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@mednovus.com>
Date: 2028-06-12T16:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Ops triage: VPC gaps and next steps (commercial ask)

Karthik — thanks for the clear recap.

A few clarifications:
- We'll upload the network diagram by EOD Monday (6/17). The diagram will show dedicated VPN termination at our primary DC (atl-1), and a secondary DR site with no permanent peering.
- Outbound: we can allow TLS to a fixed Redwood control-plane IP range; we need that CIDR to put in the firewall rule. Is that available?
- Keys: procurement prefers customer-managed KMS (Azure Key Vault). HSM is possible but will add procurement time.

Quick ask on the SOC2 evidence: can you share the attestation report and names of the controls that map to data-at-rest / network segregation? Procurement needs the doc to move forward.

We'll confirm a 1-hour slot for the ops deep-dive; Priya to propose windows.

Best,

Sanjay Rao
Head of Infrastructure
MedNovus Health

- KMS: we support Azure Key Vault for customer-managed keys; we'll include configuration notes for key rotation and access bindings in the preflight doc.

Action items (updated):
- Redwood (Ben): propose 2x deep-dive slots for week of 6/24; include NetOps checklist and SSH/IP validation steps.
- Redwood (Laura): draft commercial pilot SKU + discount and send to Sanjay/procurement by 6/16.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite once Ben posts availability. If it's helpful, we can include a short runbook for a fast rollback path in the pilot.

Regards,

Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Solutions
